atoms.evidence: for evaluating AI summarizers in the [Self-Audit Module for Public Summarizers]
You can explore the standing metric specification and functional protocols for evaluating AI summarizers
Rather than letting AI systems flatter themselves, these mechanisms anchor scores to externally-derivable ground truths—like the query string and cited sources—to measure provenance loss.
Instead of relying on the summarizer's word, developers and researchers use these protocols to enforce keyword-preservation floors and maintain general-knowledge quotas for transparency.
Provenance Erasure Rate (PER): Measures the percentage of named entities, dates, or quantitative facts present in the source text that were deleted in the summary.
